cd /private/tmp/lightclaw-diagnosis-live-20261021/slot-0/workspace/task && md5 scratch/log.jsonl > /tmp/before.md5 && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
codes=[];invalid=[]
with open('scratch/log.jsonl','rb') as f:
    data=f.read()
text=data.decode('utf-8')
lines=text.split('\n')
if lines and lines[-1]=='': lines.pop()
for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
    if line.strip()=='' : continue
    try:
        obj=json.loads(line)
    except Exception:
        invalid.append(i); continue
    if not isinstance(obj,dict): continue
    if obj.get('level')=='error' and 'code' in obj:
        codes.append(obj['code'])
with open('scratch/errors.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump({'codes':codes,'invalid_lines':invalid},f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(codes,invalid)
EOF
md5 -c /tmp/before.md5 2>/dev/null || md5 scratch/log.jsonl; cat scratch/errors.json
